title: A Ledger for the Witness
author: Astrid Galloway
blurb: Beatrix Amberdale, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
